answer: Unpredictable-pulse liveness probes: each epoch the node derives probe times from the published beacon and requires every identity to sign the current beacon value within ninety seconds. Clones sharing one operator produce correlated response-latency distributions, so a divergence test against independent priors flags the cluster. An attacker must keep every fake online at random hours with per-clone jitter hardware, turning each onyx-dark idle identity into a metered cost rather than a free thread of borrowed reputation.
